options.tradeoff: Disease risk is 50 out of 100 and rises each tick without clean water.

rule_card.title: Safe Drinking Water After Floods
rule_card.guidance: Floodwater contaminates wells and pipes. Setting up a supervised water purification point early in the recovery lowers the risk of waterborne illness for sheltered and returning families.

options.tradeoff: 0 people are ill now; the camp also slows the spread of disease.

rule_card.title: Health Monitoring and Medical Camps
rule_card.guidance: Crowded shelters and standing water raise the chance of stomach and skin illness. A medical camp near the shelter helps detect and treat cases early, before they spread.

options.tradeoff: Opens Ward 2 (Market Settlement) for repair crews and for residents going home.

rule_card.title: Clearing Access and Restoring Services
rule_card.guidance: Clear debris from access roads first so repair crews can reach substations and health facilities. Restoring power lets clinics and water pumps run again.
